name: Class of '09: The Re-Up
source:
The REJECTION SIM returns! Explore a slice of chaotic life in late 2000's American high school as you assume the role of Nicole once again. A 100% fully voiced VN presenting as the most culturally accurate period piece in the history of gaming.

It's not a sequel, it's not a remaster, it's The Re-Up! A new serving of story stems parallel to the first critically acclaimed Class of '09, the interactive sitcom you never knew you needed.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2318310/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
拒绝SIM卡回归！再次扮演Nicole的角色，探索2000年代末美国高中混乱的生活。100% 全配音VN，呈现出游戏史上文化最准确的时代作品。

这不是续集，也不是重制版，而是The Re-Up！新的故事情节与第一部广受好评的09班平行，这是一部你从来不知道自己需要的互动情景喜剧。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2318310/]Steam[/url]]
